digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, P6 acceptance-criteria quality lint
propositions: AC checklist items mentioning operational evidence (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, cloud-state, merge-gate, human-action, drill, store-surgery, recorded-attestation) but lacking [operator-attested] tag should be flagged by a deterministic advisory lint before plan submission to prevent close-gate verification cycles
The lint extends p6_ac_quality as an advisory DET check without adding a new P-level, modifying CANONICAL_DET, or adding criteria_routing.json entries, keeping DET_CHECKS at exactly 9 levels (P1–P9)

The tag matcher (_OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE) must be single-sourced in det_operator_attested.py and imported by workflow_ops.py so the plan-time lint and completion-verifier agree on what counts as tagged by construction

The deterministic lexicon must be pre-evaluated on the frozen historical AC corpus (3091 items from 556 E1 tickets) with commits ordered so eval results are committed before lint activation, demonstrating precision ≥70% on ≥50-item sample and flag rate ≤5%
Known problematic cases (tickets 115b and 8c4f) must fire on their historical untagged AC text, and already-tagged items must not be flagged, proven by unit tests
Documentation in docs/plan-review-gate.md must describe the new advisory P6-family DET lint, its flag conditions, advisory posture, and self-gate results
